observations.observation:
Visible in the 909×560 viewport: a white rounded header card containing a light-gray inner card with bold "Content editor" and the subtitle "Local drafts · changes stay in this browser"; at right, a fully rounded lavender pill reading "Open: Launch checklist" (blue text, no clipping) beside gray "Autosave: off". Alignment of pill/label with the card looks vertically centered.

Below, small-caps "DOCUMENTS" label, a bordered white select showing only "Launch checklist" (its closed state shows one option; three documents cannot be verified visually), and two-line helper text "Switch the open document — status updates live." with no truncation.

Inference: the select (~218px wide) appears wider than the ~200px sidebar column region, potentially overflowing its right edge; this could not be conclusively confirmed against the uniform background. The pink outline is an editor selection annotation, not UI.

**Visible:** Header card spans full width: bold "Content editor," gray subtitle "Local drafts · changes stay in this browser"; right-aligned lavender pill "Open: Launch checklist" plus gray "Autosave: off." Left "DOCUMENTS" panel shows a bordered item "Launch checklist" and a two-line gray helper; no dropdown caret visible. Right "DRAFT" card: full-width title input "Launch checklist," textarea with four bullets, footer with dark toggle (knob appears left) labeled "Saved" and right-aligned helper — rows aligned, spacing even. "PREVIEW" card repeats the title; only the top of its first bullet line shows.

**Clipping/fit:** The capture (569px) is shorter than source height (704px), so the Preview bullets are cut mid-line; content evidently continues below the fold. No horizontal overflow or text truncation observed.

**Fit check (960×585 viewport):**

No horizontal overflow; all content sits within margins. Header spans full width: "Content editor" title, subtitle, "Open: Launch checklist" pill, and "Autosave: off" right-aligned — all legible. Documents sidebar, Draft card, and Preview card render side by side with comfortable gaps. Draft card shows the title input, full four-bullet textarea, dark toggle labeled "Saved" (knob left despite dark track), and helper text. Preview card shows bold "Launch checklist" plus the complete bullet body, uncut.

**Issues observed:**
- Column tops are uneven — the Draft card starts visibly lower than the Preview card.
- A full-width horizontal rule near the bottom edge, with a sliver of content beneath it, is truncated by the viewport — content below the fold is cut.

**Direct observations:** Header card shows bold “Content editor,” subtitle “Local drafts · changes stay in this browser,” and a legible “Open: Launch checklist” pill plus “Autosave: off” at right. Three columns sit under it with DOCUMENTS / DRAFT / PREVIEW labels roughly top-aligned; the Documents column lacks a card wrapper while Draft and Preview are white cards. Draft and Preview share the “Launch checklist” title and four identical bullets; text is readable, no clipping, nothing exceeds the viewport. The “Saved” toggle (dark track, white knob) is legible. Background is plain light lavender — no gray seed blocks behind the title or columns.

**Possible issue:** A thin full-width blue horizontal line appears near the bottom edge (~y530) with lighter space below — a visible rule artifact, so that check appears unmet.
